nodes.title: Normal Summon Myrmeleo
nodes.body: On NS: search a Hole normal trap. Keep Trap Hole / Traptrix Trap Hole Nightmare in mind vs SS.

nodes.title: Add Hole trap
nodes.body: Prefer Traptrix Trap Hole Nightmare if you expect Synchro/Xyz; Bottomless vs big Normal.

nodes.title: Set trap + pass
nodes.body: Do not over-extend into MST. Rafflesia line is optional Extra pressure.

nodes.title: OP turn — resolve Hole
nodes.body: Chain correctly: respond to the summon, not after they already resolved a search.

chokePoints.reason: If the Hole search is interrupted (Debunk / similar), the opening dies — keep a second Hole name and Myrmeleo at 3.
Responding late after a search already resolved wastes the Hole — prefer Nightmare vs Extra summons.

flows.title: Fire / Ice Hand — bait under backrow

nodes.title: Read the backrow
nodes.body: Hands only keep timing if destroyed as Chain Link 1. Do not put them under MST as CL2+.

nodes.title: Commit Hand face-up
nodes.body: Normal or SS into a zone they want to pop. Prefer forcing a single-target destroy.

nodes.title: Destruction must be CL1
nodes.body: If their destroy is CL2 or later, Hand misses timing — no SS, no follow-up destroy.

nodes.title: Resolve SS + pop
nodes.body: Fire Hand → destroy monster; Ice Hand → destroy Spell/Trap. Then reassess push.

nodes.title: Missed timing — stop
nodes.body: You lost the Hand effect. Do not chain more blindly; rebuild resources.

chokePoints.reason: Hand miss-timing if destruction is CL2+. Without a follow-up extender the board stalls — Soul Charge / second Hand name recovers.

flows.title: Artifact — Sanctum / Ignition in OP turn

nodes.title: Artifacts set as Spell/Trap
nodes.body: Moralltach / Beagalltach face-down in S/T. Sanctum or Ignition ready.

nodes.title: Wait for a real push
nodes.body: Ideal windows: opponent SS, search that wins the game, or battle push. Avoid empty Sanctum.

nodes.title: Activate Sanctum → SS Moralltach
nodes.body: Sanctum SS an Artifact from deck. Moralltach is the default destroy answer.

nodes.title: Moralltach destroy
nodes.body: When SS'd during opponent's turn, destroy one face-up card they control.

nodes.title: Alt — Ignition protect / recycle
nodes.body: If they target your set Artifacts, Ignition can protect or set up GY plays.

chokePoints.reason: Sanctum is a Counter Trap — Wiretap / similar stops the SS. Keep Ignition and Moralltach density so the engine is not one-card.

nodes.title: Identify the threat
nodes.body: Is it a summon, an effect activation, or a search? Priority changes.

nodes.title: Summon → Hole / Black Horn
nodes.body: Trap Hole / Traptrix Trap Hole / Black Horn of Heaven vs the right summon type.

nodes.title: Effect → Fiendish / BTS
nodes.body: Fiendish Chain for continuous lockdown; Breakthrough Skill for GY follow-up later.

nodes.title: Sanctum vs Wiretap knowledge
nodes.body: Sanctum is a Counter Trap — Wiretap can negate it. Count their counters before committing.

chokePoints.reason: Wrong trap priority empties your backrow into bait. Diversify Hole / Fiendish / BTS so one MST does not end the game.

nodes.title: Set Geargiarmor
nodes.body: Armor is your engine. Protect it from easy pops when possible.

nodes.title: Flip Armor — search Geargia
nodes.body: Add Geargiaccelerator or the piece you need for Xyz.

nodes.title: SS Accelerator from hand
nodes.body: While you control a Geargia, Accelerator SS itself — extend into Rank 4 / 3 lines.

nodes.title: Make Rank play / pass with traps
nodes.body: HAT Geargia wins on resource loops + traps, not empty boards.

chokePoints.reason: Armor is the engine — if it dies before flip, the loop stops. Play 3 Armor and protect with traps / System Down awareness.

nodes.title: Discard water — SS Abyssteus
nodes.body: Teus searches a Level 4 Mermail. Track GY for later Megalo / Marksman.

nodes.title: Add Level 4 Mermail
nodes.body: Pike / Marksman / Undine lines depending on hand.

nodes.title: Respect Debunk / Soul Release
nodes.body: Choke points: Debunk on search; Soul Release / System Down from Side. Play around known counters.

nodes.title: Extend or set traps
nodes.body: HAT Mermail is resource-heavy — do not empty hand into unknown backrow without bait.

chokePoints.reason: Debunk on the Teus search bricks the open. Side Debunk awareness + enough L4 names keeps the line consistent.
